        )

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):

        self._r1_per_strength = defaultdict(list)
        self._weak_r1_gated = False
        self._current_strengths = []
        self._gate_step = 0
        self.reward_funcs = [_StrengthAwareReward(self, self.reward_funcs[0])]

    records = []
